options.counterfactual: Some pure k-decomposable complex cannot be completed on its original vertex set while keeping every intermediate complex k-decomposable, so b(d,k) is positive for at least one pair of parameters.
options.approach: Search small facet families computationally, testing recursive k-decomposability and reachability of the full skeleton through admissible facet additions. A family with no completion path would provide a concrete counterexample to the claimed zero value.
